items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I played the blues with Martha Boswell playing the organ.

ctx.x: The day that I left Austin, see we were supposed to go to Europe. And I wanted to come home before I went to Europe and they were gonna go up and down the west coast playing vaudeville, you see. And I didn't want to do that so I told him I said well I'll go home and I'll meet you in New York. We were supposed to go to England because he had been a big hit over there at one time. And so the day that I left, the day before I left rather, we made 16 sides for Vocalion. Now the only one I ever heard, and I made 8 of…
Oh. Well, what about Perini? You recorded it too.
